evidence_slice: Oxford City Council's Local Plan 2045 examination page records that the draft Oxford Local Plan 2045 was submitted to the Secretary of State on 14 July 2026 and that, by 8 September 2026, the appointed Inspectors had confirmed hearing details and Matters, Issues and Questions for Stage 1. The official SPN1 site capacity assessment identifies Diamond Place and Ewert House as Local Plan 2045 site allocation SPN1 with a site area of 1.85 hectares. The submitted site-allocation policy for SPN1 supports mixed-use development including residential use and specifies a minimum delivery of 135 dwellings, with the official assessment showing the red-line site boundary.
binding_method: submitted Local Plan examination-stage site allocation plus dedicated official site-capacity assessment and red-line boundary evidence; exact boundary extraction and canonical parcel binding delegated to local OpenCode
